title: Generator Engine UX Blueprint
description: Schema for the UX blueprint JSON consumed by make:ux-from-blueprint. Drives composite forms, wizards, shortcuts, and dashboard quick actions.

groups.description: Keyed by group name, valued as a list of snake_case table names. Only needs entries for modules used as a 'composites' or 'shortcuts' top-level key (BaseUxGenerator::getGroupForModule() resolves the host module's group from here by table name, not module name). Wizard steps/triggers_action and shortcut/dashboard 'target'/'composite' all carry their own inline "Group/ModuleName" and don't need an entry here. A composite or shortcuts host module missing from every group's list is silently skipped (0 files, no error).

composites.description: Multi-section create pages. Keys are StudlyCase parent module names.

label.description: Human-readable label for the composite form page.

wizards.description: Multi-step guided wizards. Keys are StudlyCase wizard names.

label.description: Wizard title shown at the top of the wizard page.

triggers_action.description: The module whose create action finalizes the wizard.

shortcuts.description: Quick-action shortcut panels on module detail views. Keys are StudlyCase module names of the host module.

quick_actions.description: Quick-action buttons on the main dashboard. Empty array = no files generated.

name.description: Unique section key used as a Vue ref and service key.

type.description: 'form' = single record inline form. 'repeater' = row-based table for multiple child records.

module.description: Group/ModuleName path of the module backing this section, e.g. 'Custom/SaleItems'.

optional.description: If true, the section can be skipped by the user.

label.description: Step label shown in the progress indicator.

module.description: Group/ModuleName path of the module backing this step.

type.description: 'form' = create form fields. 'repeater' = row table. 'select_or_create' = searchable dropdown + optional inline create.

wizard.description: Wizard name to launch (from top-level 'wizards' key). null to navigate directly.

prefill.description: Field values to pre-fill on the target form. Values are passed through verbatim as query params UNLESS they start with '$': '$id' -> the current record's id, '$uuid' -> its uuid, '$fieldName' -> props.record[fieldName]. A literal string value with no leading '$' is used as-is.

icon.description: Lucide icon name. Mapped to emoji in mobile cards (ShoppingCart→🛒, PackageCheck→📦, Receipt→🧾, etc.).

composite.description: StudlyCase module name if this action opens a composite form. null otherwise.

wizard.description: Wizard name to launch. null to navigate directly.
